_note: What each gate runs in this repo. G2 and close-out read this. Commands run unpiped; the exit code is the result, never a lane's report. A gate that cannot run counts as failed, never as absent.

G2._note: Two suites. The fast suite runs after every build and fix lane, on demand in a session, and when a person in session mode marks the change ready. It runs inside a time budget measured in this repo. A case that pushes it over the budget moves to the full suite. The budget is not raised. The full suite runs once, on the version that merges, on every route.

fast.tests: {{the ticket's Spec cases - only the ones its acceptance calls for. Each checks a result the story promises. A case whose result depends on real files (a loader, a parser, a catalog) runs on the real files. A case fed data made up for the test passes whatever the code does with the real ones}}
fast.smoke: {{the standing smoke set - the app starts, the main screens open, saved work reads back}}
fast.lint: {{lint command - lean: run and resolve, never folded into Builder}}
fast.budget: {{time the fast suite may take, measured in this repo}}

full.tests: {{the full test suite, including the cases moved out of the fast suite}}

G2.docs: {{docs CI - replaces both suites on a docs-only write surface}}

G2s.tokens: {{token-mirror check - parses the implementation against the token file, and the token file against the board. Design routes only, never the Spec cases}}

G4l.live: {{how to run the thing for real}}
